name: Rupak, seven beats
label: RUPAK

theka.name: The tabla, one stroke per beat

clap.name: The hand claps (the khali is a wave, no clap)

source: Rupak 3+2+2, sam 1 is khali, claps 4 and 6; Wikipedia Rupak Tala; DigiTabla; tempo a practice default; bol syllables differ between sources so only the beat structure is modelled

sources.title: Wikipedia: Rupak Tala
sources.shows: Rupak 7 matras, vibhags 3+2+2, sam and khali both on matra 1; theka Tin Tin Na X | Dhin Na 2 | Dhin Na 3 (Ram Avatar Vir 2002 p.33)

sources.title: DigiTabla: Rupak Tal
sources.shows: Rupak 7 matras, 3-2-2, sam is khali (wave), tali vibhags begin at matras 4 and 6
